sections.Profile:
"Whiz Kids" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Chicago Coin Machine Manufacturing Company in March 1952. The game features two flippers, one pop bumper, seven passive bumpers, two captive balls, and a kick-out hole.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1952
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Basketball, Sports, Original Theme
